introHtml: Custom 13 oz diner restaurant mugs offer a classic, hearty size that’s ideal for serving coffee, tea, or hot cocoa in a nostalgic setting. Unlike smaller cups, this capacity provides a generous portion that keeps customers satisfied without the need for frequent refills. Made from durable ceramic or stoneware, these mugs withstand commercial dishwasher use and maintain their vibrant imprint over time. Add your logo or design using full-color sublimation or screen printing for a lasting impression on every table.
